name: Umar Nurmagomedov

official.source: data/derived/fighters.json (68 in height, 69 in reach, orthodox, born 1996-01-03; bantamweight, 135 lb limit). Weigh-in weight not looked up.

photo_coverage: Good. 16 photos, 13 from Oct 2025 to Aug 2026. Frontal: ESPN studio headshot and stance cutout (Aug 2026), UFC 324 ceremonial (Jan 2026). Three-quarter: two clean fight-night three-quarters (UFC 321 from his left, UFC 324 from his right). Profile: right profile at the UFC Shanghai weigh-in (Aug 2026, video still). Body: two studio cutouts and many fight photos. Only one freely licensed file (CC BY 2022 video still); the rest are reference-only.

face.shape: Oval face that tapers to a narrower lower face, with prominent high cheekbones and lean, hollow cheeks. Medium length; looks compact and angular.
face.jaw: Lean and defined, moderately wide at the angles, tapering to the chin; outlined by the short beard.
face.chin: Medium width, slightly pointed under the chin beard, moderately projecting (right profile, Aug 2026). No cleft visible through the beard.
face.cheekbones: High and prominent, the widest part of the face; clear hollows below them.
face.brow_ridge: Strong; the eyes sit deep under it.
face.forehead: Broad, medium height, smooth. Hairline straight with slight temple recession and a small forward point at the centre.

eyes.shape: Almond, deep-set, with heavy, hooded upper lids; an intense, narrowed look at rest.
eyes.size: Medium, partly shadowed by the brow.

eyebrows.shape: Straight and low, close to the eyes; the inner ends dip slightly toward the nose, giving a stern look.

nose.tip: Rounded, medium size, pointing straight ahead to slightly down.

mouth.upper_lip: Thin, partly covered by the moustache
mouth.resting_expression: Closed, corners slightly down; a wide, easy smile in media and walkout photos (UFC 321, UFC 324).

ears.protrusion: Stand out moderately; obvious with the buzz cut.
ears.cauliflower_ear: Yes, both ears: thickened, lumpy upper ears with filled-in folds (right ear in the Aug 2026 profile, left ear in the UFC 321 three-quarter, both in the ESPN frontal).

face.notable_marks_scars: No large scars visible. Faint lines on the forehead.

hair.style: Buzz cut, about 6-10 mm all over (Aug 2026); slightly longer, about 1.5 cm, in Jan 2025 and 2022.
hair.colour: Dark brown to black; the scalp shows through at this length.
hair.colour_method: Strand colour estimated darker than the samples, which mix in scalp; the beard (#1c130f) is the closest clean read of his hair colour.
hair.hairline: Straight with slight temple recession and a small central point.

facial_hair.detail: Moustache joined to a chin beard that is the densest and longest part (about 2 cm), continuing along the jawline shorter and thinner (about 1 cm) to the ears. Cheeks above the jawline are bare, so from the front it reads goatee-heavy. Same shape on fight night (UFC 321, UFC 324) and in the Aug 2026 studio photos.
facial_hair.density: Dense on the chin and moustache, thinner along the jaw.
facial_hair.shape: Low cheek line following the jaw, trimmed neckline under the jaw, chin beard slightly pointed.

skin.tone_hex_method: Mean of the 9 samples not marked excluded (9x9-pixel medians). Studio samples alone average #e59d75; arena and weigh-in samples alone average #bf755a.
skin.tone_note: Light-medium skin with a warm tan. The high-key studio photos read light and golden, arena light reads deeper and redder; the recommended value sits a little above the kept mean, toward the studio read. Slightly deeper and warmer than the Islam Makhachev sheet (#e3af95).
skin.freckles_marks: None seen. Light chest and abdominal hair; hair on the forearms and shins.
skin.texture_pick_reason: Age 30 maps to middleage in avatar3d.js; swatch #e8ccb2 is lighter than the target, so the multiply tint can reach #d4936f.

body.build: Compact bantamweight (173 cm, reach 175 cm), very lean and athletic; proportions close to average, arms slightly long.
body.body_fat_notes: Very low: deep six-pack, obliques and serratus visible, vascular forearms (Aug 2026 studio).
body.shoulders: Medium-broad for his frame, round, well-defined deltoids.
body.chest: Defined pecs with a clear lower edge and centre line.
body.arms: Lean and muscular, defined biceps and triceps, vascular forearms.
body.legs_calves: Lean, defined thighs and calves; legs of average length.
body.neck: Muscular but slim, narrower than the jaw.
body.posture: Upright, square shoulders, chin level; gloves held loosely at the hips.
body.notable_physique_traits: Very low body fat and an even, athletic build; no tattoos.

fight_posture.observed: UFC 324 (Jan 2026): upright guard with both hands high, blocking a high kick with the raised right arm and shoulder (Getty a); knees from the clinch (UFC 321, Getty a); heavy top pressure on the mat (UFC 321 Getty b, UFC 324 Getty b).
fight_posture.confidence: Medium: several action stills from two fights.

tattoos.description: None: torso, arms and legs are clear in the 2025 and 2026 studio cutouts and the fight photos.

kit.typical_shorts: UFC Shanghai (Aug 2026): white shorts with a grey scalloped pattern and UFC SHANGHAI logo (studio; white also on fight night). UFC 324 fight (Jan 2026): red shorts with a white checker waistband and NURMAGOMEDOV lettering, Venum logo. UFC 321 fight (Oct 2025): black shorts. Weigh-ins: dark red and black patterned shorts. Jan 2025 studio: red shorts with dark-red and white slashes.
kit.gloves: Black UFC gloves with red cuffs (UFC 321, UFC 324).
kit.walkout: Dark red and black camouflage Venum tracksuit at the UFC 324 ceremonial weigh-in.

render_hints.hair: no proxy: buzz cut as a dense dark scalp tint #2a1f1a
render_hints.beard: short beard with a low cheek line, densest on the chin and moustache (goatee-heavy), #1c130f

morphs_not_in_embed._note: assets/embed/mh-manifest.json has no ear targets. Estimates for standard MakeHuman ear modifiers in case they are added; both ears are cauliflowered.

notes: Confidence: high for hair, beard, skin range, no tattoos and build; medium-high for face proportions (sharp frontal, two clean three-quarters, one profile video still); low-to-medium for exact morph values. Watch for: (1) High, prominent cheekbones with hollow cheeks and a tapering lower face are the key structure. (2) Deep-set, hooded dark eyes under thick, low, straight brows give the stern look; he smiles widely when relaxed. (3) The beard is goatee-heavy: dense chin and moustache, thinner along the jaw, bare cheeks; it is not a full beard. (4) Buzz cut, so render as scalp tint, no hair proxy. (5) Cauliflower ears on both sides. (6) Very lean bantamweight: deep abs, narrow waist. macro/ageOldM 0.077 follows avatar3d.js (30-25)/65; heightDownM 0.18 matches the 172.7 cm Chandler sheet.
